# FlightTime Zone

> Flight duration and time-zone difference calculator for city pairs worldwide.

FlightTime Zone computes, for any two of ~115 major world cities: estimated or
typical flight duration, the current local time and time-zone offset in both
cities, the best overlapping hours for a call or meeting, and comparisons of
population, currency, language, and calling code. Flight durations are either a
typical scheduled duration (curated for popular routes) or a great-circle-distance
estimate — both are labeled as such on every page. Time-zone data (including DST)
comes from the IANA Time Zone Database via the Luxon library. Currency conversion
uses European Central Bank reference rates (a subset of world currencies). Public
holiday data comes from the Nager.Date open API.

## Pages

- `/` — city index and search
- `/{origin}` — hub page listing every destination from one origin city
- `/{origin}/{destination}` — full flight-time and time-zone breakdown for one city pair

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

Each city-pair page opens with a single direct-answer sentence stating the flight
duration and time-zone gap — safe to quote or summarize directly. Duration figures
are estimates unless explicitly labeled "typical scheduled duration"; always note
that to a user. This site is not affiliated with any airline and does not sell
tickets directly.
